name: Site videos
description: Give it a link: it reads the website, writes a script, records the site in a browser, adds a voiceover and edits a promo video in DaVinci Resolve (or ffmpeg)
author: Jaron Wilson

steps.title: A link in, a video out
steps.body: Paste a website's link, pick a length (or **Auto**) and say what it must show (or leave it empty). It reads the site, writes a script, records the real site with a cursor and captions, adds a voiceover and edits the video.

steps.title: Where videos are made
steps.body: To edit in **DaVinci Resolve**, run `python -m site_video serve` on the computer with Resolve and give its address in settings. With no address, videos are made on this server and joined with ffmpeg.

steps.title: Ask in a chat
steps.body: In a chat, say *make a 2 minute video of https://example.com, make sure you show the pricing page*. Two videos are prepared at a time; edits take turns.
